blurb: Lakefront Boating offers private boat rentals and bareboat charters on Lake Michigan and the Chicago River. Guests can explore popular destinations like the Chicago Playpen and enjoy onboard amenities such as restrooms, refrigerators, and Bluetooth sound systems. Captains are available for hire separately, and guests may operate the vessel themselves if qualified.
extraNote: Charter time starts at scheduled departure; late arrivals shorten rental time without refund · Captain has final authority over vessel operation and guest conduct · Cancellation and rescheduling terms shown at booking; weather cancellations get full credit · No refunds for early charter termination due to guest misconduct · Weather cancellations receive full credit usable anytime; light rain and passing storms are charterable · Dock "i" at Diversey Harbor, Lincoln Park, Chicago, IL 60614

quotes.text: I couldn't recommend Captain Lisa and Lakefront Boating higher. I rented a boat to surprise my fiance immediately after I proposed to her on the Chicago riverwalk. Lisa went above and beyond, from the moment I said "go," to curate a schedule and plan the boat ride to perfection. On the day of the celebration she was kind, courteous and professional toward myself and toward our families and guests. The day that we got engaged simply would not have been as perfect as it was without her help." Engagement Celebration Verified Guest

Lived here for 7 years now rented many boats an this one by far has been the best experience!! The captain is amazing, super nice and very accommodating - knows what he is doing!! The boat was nice and clean and had towels an waters all ready cups sunblock all the little things you might forget! Great price can't beat it!! I'll will be back for sure!!" 2024 Summer Charter Verified Guest

The captain and his boat were great for my friend's bachelorette party. He provided a good sound system, coolers, and was very accommodating to what we wanted even though the day we went had very choppy waters. 10/10 experience out on Lake Michigan!" 2022 Bachelorette Party Verified Guest

We booked the 48' for a corporate team outing and it was absolutely perfect. The crew handled everything — setup, music, even helped coordinate our catering delivery. Our team is still talking about it weeks later. Already planning our next one!" 2024 Corporate Event Verified Guest

Took my parents out for their 40th anniversary on the 46' and it was magical. Cruising past the skyline at sunset with the city lights coming on — you can't beat it. Captain was so thoughtful and made the whole evening special." Anniversary Celebration Verified Guest

We took the 36' Sea Ray out for the Chicago air show. Captain Lisa was great and the boat was spacious for 13 ppl. We sat in the water on the lily pad that was provided. Great day on the water." 2024 Chicago Air & Water Show Verified Guest
